37: Result<std::string> Connection::read_until(const std::string& delimiter,
38:                                            const size_t max_buffer_size) {
39:     while (true) {
40:         size_t pos = read_buffer.find(delimiter);
41:         if (pos != std::string::npos) {
42:             size_t extract_len = pos + delimiter.size();
43:             std::string result = read_buffer.substr(0, extract_len);
44:             read_buffer.erase(0, extract_len);
45:             return result;
46:         }
47: 
48:         std::array<char, READ_CHUNK_SIZE> temp_buf;
49:         ssize_t bytes_read = ::read(fd, temp_buf.data(), sizeof(temp_buf));
50: 
51:         if (bytes_read < 0) {
52:             if (errno == EINTR) {
53:                 continue;
54:             }
55:             return std::unexpected(
56:                 make_err(ErrCode::ConnectionReadFailed, errno));
57:         }
58: 
59:         if (bytes_read == 0) {
60:             return std::unexpected(
61:                 make_err(ErrCode::ConnectionClosedBeforeDelimiter));
62:         }
63: 
64:         read_buffer.append(temp_buf.data(), bytes_read);
65: 
66:         if (read_buffer.size() > max_buffer_size) {
67:             return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::RequestHeaderTooLarge));
68:         }
69:     }
70: }

107: Result<AppConfig> load_config(std::string_view path) {
108:     std::ifstream fin{ std::string(path) };
109:     if (!fin.is_open()) {
110:         return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigFileNotFound));
111:     }
112: 
113:     AppConfig config = default_config();
114:     std::string line;
115:     while (std::getline(fin, line)) {
116:         std::string_view view = trim(line);
117:         if (view.empty() || view.front() == '#') {
118:             continue;
119:         }
120: 
121:         auto eq = view.find('=');
122:         if (eq == std::string_view::npos) {
123:             return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigParseFailed));
124:         }
125: 
126:         std::string_view key = trim(view.substr(0, eq));
127:         std::string_view value = trim(view.substr(eq + 1));
128: 
129:         if (key == "net.port") {
130:             auto parsed = parse_int(value);
131:             if (!parsed) {
132:                 return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigParseFailed));
133:             }
134:             config.net_config.port = *parsed;
135:         } else if (key == "net.backlog") {
136:             auto parsed = parse_int(value);
137:             if (!parsed) {
138:                 return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigParseFailed));
139:             }
140:             config.net_config.backlog = *parsed;
141:         } else if (key == "net.worker_count") {
142:             auto parsed = parse_int(value);
143:             if (!parsed) {
144:                 return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigParseFailed));
145:             }
146:             config.net_config.worker_count = *parsed;
147:         } else if (key == "net.reuseAddress") {
148:             auto parsed = parse_bool(value);
149:             if (!parsed) {
150:                 return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigParseFailed));
151:             }
152:             config.net_config.reuseAddress = *parsed;
153:         } else if (key == "http.max_body_size") {
154:             auto parsed = parse_size(value);
155:             if (!parsed) {
156:                 return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigParseFailed));
157:             }
158:             config.http_config.max_body_size = *parsed;
159:         } else if (key == "http.max_header_size") {
160:             auto parsed = parse_size(value);
161:             if (!parsed) {
162:                 return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigParseFailed));
163:             }
164:             config.http_config.max_header_size = *parsed;
165:         } else if (key == "log.max_lines_per_file") {
166:             auto parsed = parse_size(value);
167:             if (!parsed) {
168:                 return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigParseFailed));
169:             }
170:             config.log_config.max_lines = *parsed;
171:         } else {
172:             return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ConfigParseFailed));
173:         }
174:     }

177:         return std::unexpected(res.error());
178:     }
179:
